gates.name: reference-agreement:spectrogram_vs_scipy
gates.detail: 7/7 agree [max_diff_scipy=6.8212e-13 vs ref 0; n_freqs=129 vs ref 129; n_windows=11 vs ref 11; median_peak_freq_hz=11.25 vs ref 11.25; n_windows_alpha_peak=11 vs ref 11; alpha_power_cv_pct=57.923 vs ref 57.923; mean_alpha_power=2464.8 vs ref 2464.8]
gates.citation: Allen JB (1977). Short-term spectral analysis, synthesis, and modification by discrete Fourier transform. IEEE Trans ASSP 25(3):235-238. Reference impl: scipy.signal.spectrogram (Virtanen et al. 2020). Data: EEG Motor Movement/ Imagery Database (eegmmidb), PhysioNet.

reference.citation: Allen JB (1977). Short-term spectral analysis, synthesis, and modification by discrete Fourier transform. IEEE Trans ASSP 25(3):235-238. Reference impl: scipy.signal.spectrogram (Virtanen et al. 2020). Data: EEG Motor Movement/ Imagery Database (eegmmidb), PhysioNet.
reference.description: re-computes the full frequency x time power matrix with scipy.signal.spectrogram (symmetric Hann, nperseg=256, noverlap=128, detrend=False, scaling='density', mode='psd'), and reports the bit-exact scipy agreement (~7e-13) over all cells, the frequency x time dimensions, the median peak-power frequency, the count of windows whose peak is in alpha, the alpha-power waxing/waning (CV), and the mean alpha power
